title: Sierrendipity: a browser-based Olympiad coding tutor
description: As a high-school student preparing for coding Olympiads, I want a browser IDE that compiles and runs Python, C, and C++ projects with interactive input, so that I can learn from lessons and practice from anywhere. Lessons are added one by one by the tutor, the student, and Claude. Out of scope for now: more than one student, languages beyond Python/C/C++, automatic grading against hidden test suites. Definition of Done: the student can sign in, open a lesson, edit a multi-file project, run it interactively, and see results; the platform scales to zero when idle and costs pennies per month; every behavior is covered by a passing Gherkin specification.
right_now_summary: The team is building the browser IDE with interactive runs, recovery, and safe code execution.
